Features

Everything you need to ship an Android app

No Android Studio. No Java. Just paste a URL or upload a ZIP.

URL → APK

Paste any live website URL and get an APK that loads your site in a native Android WebView — no internet required if you use offline mode.

ZIP → APK

Got a local HTML/CSS/JS project? Zip it up and upload it. As long as there's an index.html, it will be packaged into a working APK.

Offline Mode

APK Builder downloads your entire website and bundles it inside the APK so it works without any internet connection on the device.

Custom App Config

Set your app name, package ID, version, orientation, status bar color, and custom icon — all from a clean UI with no code editing.

Real-time Build Log

Watch your APK being built live with a streaming log powered by Socket.io. See every step from project creation to compilation.

Dual Output

If Android SDK is installed you get a direct APK download. Otherwise you get a ready-to-open Android Studio project ZIP — always something to take away.

How it works

From URL to APK in 3 steps

No complicated setup. Just run one command and use the web UI.

01

Install & Start

Install the package globally with npm. Run apk-builder and it opens the web UI in your browser automatically.

PowerShell / Terminal 
$ npm install -g apk-builder-web
$ apk-builder
02

Choose your source

Either paste a website URL (online or offline mode) or drag & drop a ZIP file containing your web app. Fill in your app name and package ID.

🌐 Web URL
📦 ZIP File
https://your-website.com
My App
com.you.myapp
⚒ Build APK
03

Download & Install

Watch the real-time build log. When done, download the APK straight to your phone or get the Android Studio project ZIP to sign and publish to the Play Store.

Download APK
Download Android Studio Project
Install

Get started in 30 seconds

One command installs everything. Works on Windows, macOS and Linux.

📦
Node.js ≥ 18
nodejs.org →
☕
Java JDK 17+ (optional, for APK builds)
adoptium.net →
🤖
Android SDK (optional, for APK builds)
Android Studio →
Install & run 
# Install globally
$ npm install -g apk-builder-web

# Run it — browser opens automatically
$ apk-builder

# Optional: use a different port
$ apk-builder --port 8080
Clone & run from source 
$ git clone https://github.com/YOUR_USERNAME/apk-builder.git
$ cd apk-builder
$ npm install
$ node server.js

Then open http://localhost:3000 in your browser.

FAQ

Common questions

Without Android SDK / Java JDK on your machine, APK Builder still works — instead of a direct APK, it gives you a ready-to-open Android Studio project ZIP. Open that in Android Studio and press ▶ Run to build the APK.
Make sure your ZIP has index.html at the root and all asset paths are relative (e.g. ./style.css, not /style.css). Absolute paths don't work in the bundled offline WebView.
The debug APK is for testing only. To publish, open the Android Studio project ZIP in Android Studio → Build → Generate Signed Bundle / APK. This creates a release-signed APK you can submit to the Play Store.
It downloads HTML, CSS, JS, images and fonts (up to 200 assets). Dynamically loaded resources, APIs, and third-party CDNs that are fetched at runtime will still need internet on the device.
No. APK Builder runs 100% on your own machine. Nothing is sent to a remote server. Your files and URLs never leave your computer.
